title: Facebook News Feed: Complete Design
description: Design facebook news feed with OOP principles, class diagrams, and scalable C# implementations.

data.text: Design a facebook news feed using object-oriented principles. Focus on clean class design, proper encapsulation, and extensible architecture.

data.caption: Interaction flow for Facebook News Feed. Shows how components collaborate to fulfill a user request.
data.definition:
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant S as FacebookNewsFeedService
    participant US as User
    participant PO as Post
    participant FE as Feed
    participant CO as Comment

    C->>S: Request
    S->>PO: CreatePost()
    PO-->>S: Result
    S->>FE: AddComment()
    FE-->>S: Result
    S->>CO: LikePost()
    CO-->>S: Result
    S->>CO: GenerateFeed()
    CO-->>S: Result
    S-->>C: Response

Design Principles Applied
data.text: Use composition over inheritance. Keep entities simple. Use interfaces to decouple services from implementations. Apply CQRS when read and write patterns diverge.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Encapsulate state inside entities; expose behavior, not data
Strategy and Command patterns make behavior pluggable
Dependency injection keeps classes loosely coupled
data.takeaway: Facebook News Feed demonstrates how clean OOP design leads to maintainable, testable code that can evolve with requirements.
